summary.name: DBeaver
summary.one_liner: DBeaver is a universal SQL client and database management tool; this page lists the changelog for version 26.2.3 (October 18, 2026).
use_cases: Writing and running SQL scripts against multiple databases
Browsing and editing table data in a result grid
Exporting or importing data between databases and files
Managing database connections and SSH tunnels
summary.what_it_does: The page is the release notes for DBeaver 26.2.3. It lists changes across the AI Assistant (image attachments and drag-and-drop in AI Chat), the SQL Editor (running script files without opening them), the Data Editor, data transfer wizards, and connectivity (SSH known-hosts error messages). It also covers security fixes, including a confirmation prompt before shell commands that retrieve connection passwords and an lz4-java library update. Driver-specific fixes are listed for ClickHouse, CUBRID, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server, and YashanDB support is added. The page does not describe the overall feature set beyond these changes.
notable: Release notes for DBeaver 26.2.3 with AI Assistant, SQL Editor, and driver updates
Adds YashanDB driver support and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) localization
Security fixes: confirmation before shell commands used to fetch connection passwords; lz4-java update
caveats: The page is a changelog and does not state pricing or the full list of platforms
Some items are platform-specific fixes (for example Linux, macOS dark mode, Eclipse with TM4E)
